takeaway: The mitral valve is best heard over the apex beat, at the 5th left intercostal space in the midclavicular line.

lines.text: A thirty-five-year-old woman is short of breath, and she is diagnosed with mitral stenosis.
Here is the narrowed mitral valve.
On auscultation there is an opening snap, and a mid-diastolic murmur with presystolic accentuation.
Where are these sounds best heard? The mitral valve is best heard over the apex beat,
at the fifth left intercostal space, in the midclavicular line.
So for mitral stenosis, put the stethoscope on the apex: fifth left intercostal space, midclavicular line.
